value.rationale: The natural graph automorphism group contains row-column exchange, yet its action cannot be recovered from the known side-preserving module. The exact five swap class traces resolve the sign-extension ambiguity of a nine-dimensional tensor representation and yield a complete 20-class rational character on a canonical capacity-two multiple-chessboard complex, a motivated symmetry invariant beyond a known rank fifteen.
